text: The term "Austronesian" traces ancestral language connections across disparate peoples from island and mainland Southeast Asia, Taiwan and parts of insular southern China, and the Pacific Islands, and it extends from Madagascar in the west to Rapa Nui in the east. The volume explores this diverse and expansive domain through an introduction and fifteen separate essays, each focused on the ethnography of musical practices from a specific area.
